programs.title: Unsellable Houses
programs.desc: Lyndsay and Leslie's cousin can't seem to sell his home, and between the unfinished projects and wild walls, it's easy to see why. The twins aim to bring in a natural style that will fit the neighbourhood.

programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.desc: A married couple from San Jose are looking for a home in the remote town of Manchester, California. Inventory in this picturesque community is low, and finding a property that's also affordable is going to be tough.

programs.title: The Block
programs.desc: Tonight it's a Block wedding when 2012 contestants Brad and Lara get married. Everyone enjoys a night off from renovating followed by a leisurely lunch with Scotty. But he and Shelley have a surprise challenge and its fans v faves.

programs.title: Flip Or Flop
programs.desc: Hosts Aubrey and Bristol take a risk when they purchase a small, cramped one-bedroom condominium that boasts one bathroom sight unseen, and then they conduct a sweeping renovation on the home in order to sell it for a profit.

programs.title: Flip Or Flop
programs.desc: Tarek and Christina team up with their friend Pete De Best on a house in Yorba Linda, CA. They've flipped houses with Pete, but he's a major penny pincher, and they must convince him that you have to spend money to make money.

programs.title: Small Town Potential
programs.desc: A newlywed couple looks to settle down in a family house. Davina and Kristin look to find an amazing property that they can transform into a charming home.
